versions.changelog:
Initial release providing a complete workflow for converting articles to science video scripts.

- Automatically parses articles, academic papers, or reports into structured video scripts.
- Supports both short-form (Douyin/TikTok, 30–60s) and long-form (Bilibili, 8–15min) science videos.
- Offers two production modes: on-camera presenter and fully AI-generated (information visualization only).
- Outputs include: detailed video script, shot list with English visual prompts, subtitles, and editing guide.
- No creation of actual video, image, or audio assets—users combine final video in CapCut or similar tools.
